As of my last knowledge update in September 2021, Ahmad Faruqui is an economist known for his expertise in energy and environmental issues, especially relating to the electricity sector. He has extensively researched and supported the implementation of dynamic pricing and demand response programs in the energy market. These concepts aim to modify consumer use of electricity in response to supply conditions, thereby improving efficiency and sustainability in electricity consumption.

Ahmad Faruqui has written numerous papers, articles, and books on the subject, advocating for reforms in electricity pricing to better align consumer behavior with the true costs and availability of electricity. His work often discusses the potential for dynamic pricing to enhance grid reliability, reduce emissions, and lower costs.

He holds a Ph.D. in Economics from the University of California, Davis. Over the years, he has been associated with several prestigious institutions and think tanks, contributing to policy debates and regulatory discussions around the world.

Given that updates may have occurred beyond my last update, I recommend checking the most recent sources for the latest information regarding his activities and publications.
